name: 78705 · Austin, TX
findings: ZIP 78705 (Austin) has 177 nonprofit organizations. 98 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 91 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78705 (Austin) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
